cnd17:2.3: paṭhamenapi jhānena jhāyī, dutiyenapi jhānena jhāyī, tatiyenapi jhānena jhāyī, catutthenapi jhānena jhāyī, savitakka savicārenapi jhānena jhāyī, avitakka vicāramattenapi jhānena jhāyī, avitakkaavicārenapi jhānena jhāyī, sappītikenapi jhānena jhāyī, nippītikenapi jhānena jhāyī, sātasahagatenapi jhānena jhāyī, upekkhāsahagatenapi jhānena jhāyī, suññatenapi jhānena jhāyī, animittenapi jhānena jhāyī, appaṇihitenapi jhānena jhāyī, lokiyenapi jhānena jhāyī, lokuttarenapi jhānena jhāyī. jhānarato ekattamanuyutto sadatthagarukoti
cnd17:2.5: virajanti: rāgo rajo, doso rajo, moho rajo, kodho rajo, upanāho rajo …pe… sabbākusalābhisaṃkhārā rajā.
cnd17:2.6: te rajā buddhassa bhagavato pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
cnd17:2.7: tasmā buddho arajo virajo nirajo rajāpagato rajavippahīno rajavippamutto sabbarajavītivatto.
cnd17:3.1: “rāgo rajo na ca pana reṇu vuccati
cnd17:4.1: doso rajo na ca pana reṇu vuccati
cnd17:5.1: moho rajo na ca pana reṇu vuccati
cnd17:8.2: athavā bhagavā sabbossukkapaṭippassaddhattā āsīno, vutthavāso so vutthavāso ciṇṇacaraṇo …pe… jātimaraṇasaṃsāro-natthi tassa punabbhavo”ti.
cnd17:10.1: …pe… katakiccaṃ anāsavanti: buddhassa bhagavato kiccākiccaṃ karaṇīyākaraṇīyaṃ pahīnaṃ ucchinnamūlaṃ tālāvatthukataṃ anabhāvakataṃ āyatiṃ anuppādadhammaṃ,

cnd17:13.1: pāraguṃ sabbadhammānanti: bhagavā abhiññāpāragū, pariññāpāragū pahānapāragū, bhāvanāpāragū, sacchikiriyāpāragū, samāpattipāragū,
cnd17:13.2: abhiññāpāragū, sabbadhammānaṃ, pariññāpāragū, sabbadukkhānaṃ, pahānapāragū sabbakilesānaṃ, bhāvanāpāragū catunnaṃ maggānaṃ, sacchikiriyāpāragū nirodhassa, samāpattipāragū sabbasamāpattīnaṃ,
cnd17:13.7: so pāragato pāramippatto antagato antappatto, koṭigato koṭippatto, pariyantagato pariyantappatto, vosānagato vosānappatto, tāṇagato tāṇappatto, lenagato lenappatto, saraṇagato saraṇappatto, abhayagato abhayappatto, accutagato accutappatto, amatagato amatappatto, nibbānagato nibbānappatto.
cnd17:14.1: atthi pañhena āgamanti: pañhena atthikāmha āgatā, pañhaṃ pucchitukāmamha āgatā. paññaṃ sotukāmā āgatamhāti ‘evampi ‘atthi pañhena āgamaṃ’
cnd17:14.2: athavā pañhatthikānaṃ pañhaṃ pucchitukāmānaṃ pañhaṃ sotukāmānaṃ. āgamanaṃ abhikkamanaṃ upasaṅkamanaṃ payirupāsanaṃ atthi, evampi atthi pañhena āgamaṃ,
cnd17:14.3: athavā pañhāgamo tuyhaṃ atthi, tvampi pahū, tvamasi alamatto mayā pucchitaṃ kathetuṃ vissajjetuṃ, vahassetaṃ bhāranti evampi ‘atthi pañhena āgamaṃ’.
cnd17:15.1: aññāvimokkhaṃ pabrūhī ti: ‘aññā vimokkho’ vuccati arahattavimokkho,
cnd17:15.2: arahattavimokkhaṃ pabrūhi ācikkhāhi desehi paññapehi paṭṭhapehi vivarāhi vibhajāhi uttānīkarohi pakāsehīti
cnd17:16.1: avijjāya pabhedananti avijjāya bhedanaṃ pabhedanaṃ pahānaṃ vūpasamo paṭinissaggo paṭippassaddhaṃ amataṃ nibbānanti
cnd17:19.2: “yo kāmesu kāmacchando kāmarāgo kāmanandi kāmataṇhā kāmasineho kāmapipāsā kāmapariḷāho kāmajjhosānaṃ kāmogho kāmayogo kāmūpādānaṃ kāmacchandanīvaraṇaṃ.
cnd17:19.3: “pahānaṃ kāmacchandānanti: kāmacchandānaṃ pahānaṃ vūpasamaṃ paṭinissaggaṃ paṭippassaddhiṃ amataṃ nibbānanti
cnd17:20.2: “yaṃ cetasikaṃ asātaṃ cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ cetosamphassajaṃ asātaṃ dukkhaṃ vedayitaṃ, cetosamphassajā asātā dukkhā vedanā.
cnd17:20.3: domanassāna cūbhayanti: kāmacchandassa ca domanassassa ca ubhinnaṃ pahānaṃ vūpasamo paṭinissaggo paṭippassaddhi amataṃ nibbānanti
cnd17:21.2: ‘thīna’nti ‘yā cittassa akallatā akammaññatā olīyanā sallīyanā līnā līyanā līyitattaṃ thīnaṃ thīyanā thīyitattaṃ cittassa.”
cnd17:21.3: thīnassa ca panūdananti: thīnassa ca panūdanaṃ pahānaṃ vūpasamo paṭinissaggo paṭippassaddhi amataṃ nibbānanti
cnd17:22.2: ‘kukkucca’nti: hatthakukkuccampi kukkuccaṃ pādakukkuccampi kukkuccaṃ, hatthapādakukkuccampi kukkuccaṃ.
cnd17:22.5: “yaṃ evarūpaṃ kukkuccaṃ kukkuccāyanā kukkuccāyitattaṃ cetaso vippaṭisāro manovilekho. idaṃ vuccati kukkuccaṃ’.
cnd17:22.6: api ca dvīhi kāraṇehi uppajjati kukkuccaṃ: cetaso vippaṭisāro manovilekho,
cnd17:22.8: kathaṃ katattā ca akatattā ca uppajjati kukkuccaṃ cetaso vippaṭisāro manovilekho:
cnd17:22.9: ‘kataṃ me kāyaduccaritaṃ akataṃ me kāyasucarita’nti uppajjati kukkuccaṃ cetaso vippaṭisāro manovilekho’
cnd17:22.10: kataṃ me vacīduccaritaṃ akataṃ me vacīsucaritanti …pe…
cnd17:22.11: kataṃ me manoduccaritaṃ akataṃ me manosucarita’nti …pe…
cnd17:22.12: kato me pāṇātipāto akatā me pāṇātipātā veramaṇīti …pe…
cnd17:22.13: kataṃ me adinnādānaṃ akataṃ me adinnādānā veramaṇīti …pe…
cnd17:22.14: kato me kāmesu micchācāro akatā me kāmesu micchācārā veramaṇīti …pe…
cnd17:22.15: kato me musāvādo akatā me musāvādā veramaṇīti …pe…
cnd17:22.16: katā me pisunāvācā akatā me pisunāya vācāya veramaṇīti …pe…
cnd17:22.17: katā me pharusāvācā akatā me pharusāya vācāya veramaṇīti …pe…
cnd17:22.18: kato me samphappalāpo akatā me samphappalāpā veramaṇīti …pe…
cnd17:22.19: katā me abhijjhā akatā me anabhijjhāti …pe…
cnd17:22.20: kato me vyāpādo akato me abyāpādoti …pe…
cnd17:22.21: katā me micchādiṭṭhi akatā me sammādiṭṭhīti uppajjati kukkuccaṃ cetaso vippaṭisāro manovilekho.
cnd17:22.22: evaṃ katattā ca akatattā ca uppajjati kukkuccaṃ cetaso vippaṭisāro manovilekho.
cnd17:23.1: athavā ‘sīlesumbhi na paripūrakārī’ti uppajjati kukkuccaṃ cetaso vippaṭisāro manovilekho.
cnd17:23.6: abhāvitā me cattāro satipaṭṭhānāti-abhāvitā me cattāro sammappadhānāti-abhāvitā me cattāro iddhipādāti-abhāvitāni me pañcindriyānīti-abhāvitāni me pañcabalānīti-abhāvitā me satta bojjhaṅgāti-abhāvito me ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggoti-
cnd17:23.7: dukkhaṃ me apariññātanti-samudayo me appahīnoti-maggo me abhāvitoti-nirodho me asacchikato ti uppajjati kukkuccaṃ cetaso vippaṭisāro manovilekho.
cnd17:24.1: kukkuccānaṃ nivāraṇanti: kukkuccānaṃ āvaraṇaṃ nīvaraṇaṃ pahānaṃ vūpasamo paṭinissaggo paṭippassaddhi amataṃ nibbānanti
cnd17:27.2: yā catutthe jhāne upekkhā upekkhanā ajjhupekkhanā cittasamatho cittapassaddhatā majjhattatā cittassa.
cnd17:27.3: satīti: “yā catutthe jhāne upekkhaṃ ārabbha sati anussati …pe… sammāsati’.
cnd17:27.4: upekkhāsatisaṃsuddhanti: catutthe jhāne upekkhā ca sati ca suddhā honti visuddhā saṃsuddhā parisuddhā pariyodātā anaṅgaṇā vigatūpakkilesā mudubhūtā kammaniyā ṭhitā āneñjappattāti
cnd17:28.2: so ādito hoti, purato hoti, pubbaṅgamo hoti, aññāvimokkhassāti evampi ‘dhammatakkapurejavaṃ’.
cnd17:28.4: sā ādito hoti, purato hoti, pubbaṅgamā hoti, aññāvimokkhassāti evampi ‘dhammatakkapurejavaṃ’.
cnd17:28.6: sā ādito hoti, purato hoti, pubbaṅgamā hoti aññāvimokkhassāti
cnd17:29.2: arahattavimokkhaṃ pabrūmi, ācikkhāmi desemi paññapemi paṭṭhapemi vivarāmi vibhajāmi uttānīkaromi pakāsemīti

cnd17:33.1: su saṃyojano lokoti: kiṃ lokassa saṃyojanaṃ lagganaṃ bandhanaṃ upakkileso,
cnd17:33.2: kena loko yutto payutto āyutto samāyutto laggo laggito paḷibuddhoti
cnd17:34.1: kiṃ su tassa vivāraṇanti: ‘kiṃ tassa’ cāraṇaṃ vicāraṇaṃ paṭivicāraṇaṃ
cnd17:34.4: kissassa vippahānena nibbānaṃ iti vuccatīti: kissassa vippahānena vūpasamena paṭinissaggena paṭippassaddhiyā, nibbānaṃ iti vuccati pavuccati kathīyati bhaṇīyati dīpīyati voharīyatīti
cnd17:37.2: yo rāgo sārāgo …pe… abhijjhā lobho akusalamūlaṃ. “ayaṃ vuccati nandi.
cnd17:37.3: yā nandi lokassa saṃyojanaṃ lagganaṃ bandhanaṃ upakkileso, imāya nandiyā loko yutto payutto āyutto samāyutto laggo laggito paḷibuddhoti
cnd17:38.3: kāmavitakko vyāpādavitakko vihiṃsāvitakko ñātivitakko janapadavitakko amaravitakko parānuddayatāpaṭisaṃyutto vitakko lābhasakkārasiloka paṭisaṃyutto vitakko anavaññattipaṭisaṃyutto vitakko
cnd17:38.5: ime navavitakkā lokassa cāraṇā vicāraṇā paṭivicāraṇā.
cnd17:38.6: imehi navahi vitakkehi loko carati vicarati paṭivicaratīti
cnd17:39.3: taṇhāya vippahānena nibbānaṃ iti vuccatīti. taṇhāya vippahānena vūpasamena paṭinissaggena paṭippassaddhiyā nibbānaṃ iti vuccati pavuccati kathīyati bhaṇīyati dīpīyati voharīyatīti

cnd17:48.1: bahiddhā ca vedanaṃ nābhinandatoti: ajjhattaṃ vedanāsu vedanānupassī viharanto vedanaṃ nābhinandati nābhivadati na ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati abhinandanaṃ abhivadanaṃ ajjhosānaṃ gāhaṃ parāmāsaṃ abhinivesaṃ pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃgameti
